mcp.catalog.memoryBlockedHint: These servers keep a second memory outside EYAS (a knowledge graph, a vector store or a note vault). EYAS reads and writes memory only through its own stores, so they cannot be installed for any model. To bring that memory into EYAS, use a one-way import.
mcp.server.memoryBlockedReason: Blocked: this server keeps memory outside EYAS or points at a protected folder (another tool's memory, a note vault or the EYAS data folder). It is never started and its tools reach no model. Remove it, or bring the memory in with a one-way import.
mcp.error.memoryStoreBlocked: This MCP server keeps memory outside EYAS or points at a protected folder, so EYAS will not run it. For a one-way import use Settings → System → Data portability → Import data instead.
